messages:
alex.partnerships: Ok looping in the team — we got a request from TitanEdge (hardware partner) for the marketplace listing. They need our SOC2 artifacts, pen-test summary, and an upload we can hand to their SI. TL;DR: they want an evidence bundle by next Wed.

maya.security: Thanks. We have a redacted SOC2 Type II PDF and pen-test exec summary. Full pen-test report is sensitive — legal needs to review before sharing.

sam.partner-eng: For the SI integration they want firmware hashes + attestations for the appliance images. Also asking for a sample config and the API endpoint cert chain.

priya.ops: Logistics: do we want to generate presigned S3 links or place everything into a partner S3 bucket with cross-account access? Pref: presigned links with 7-day TTL and one-time download.

jordan.legal: We need a data sharing addendum signed before we hand over any raw reports. Redacted SOC2 ok to share now, full pen-test only after AAD is signed and we confirm scope.

maya.security: Agreed. Also want to ensure artifacts are encrypted at rest and that presigned URLs are scoped to specific files. I'll prepare a checklist of items to include.

alex.partnerships: Action items: 1) Maya — create artifact bundle and mark redactions. 2) Priya — create presigned links and set TTL. 3) Sam — collate firmware hashes and cert chain. 4) Jordan — send AAD to TitanEdge legal.

priya.ops: For presigned links I'll use the following pattern and post in thread after approval:
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-partner-evidence/titanedge/2024-06-??/bundle.zip --expires-in 604800
```
I'll also add Content-Disposition to force filename.

maya.security: Checklist draft (short):
- SOC2 Type II (redacted) PDF
- Pen-test executive summary (public)
- Full pen-test report (conditional, share after AAD)
- Firmware hashes + attestations (signed)
- TLS cert chain for API endpoints
- Integration sample config (no secrets)
- Contact + owner metadata file

sam.partner-eng: One more: TitanEdge asked for a statement of the scope we scanned (prod vs staging). We should add a small YAML manifest like:
```
scanned_services:
  - inference-gateway (prod)
  - model-store (prod)
  - config-service (staging)
```
And a k8s namespace list.

jordan.legal: I'll draft the AAD and include a clause: no redistribution, limited retention (30 days unless extended by signed agreement). That will impact TTL — Priya, can you set 7-day links and we can extend per request?

priya.ops: Yep 7 days by default, extension on written approval. I'll keep an internal ticket to rotate links on extension.

alex.partnerships: Timeline check — today is Fri. If TitanEdge wants bundle by next Wed, we need artifacts ready by Tue COB to give legal time. Can each owner confirm?

maya.security: I can get redacted SOC + exec summary by Mon EOD.

sam.partner-eng: Firmware hashes and cert chain — I need to pull signatures and get them signed by infra team. Target Tue morning.

jordan.legal: AAD draft out by Mon midday.

priya.ops: I'll prep the S3 folder and placeholder links; will only activate presign once legal gives OK.

deploy-bot: Deployed ticket PARTNER-5123 to #partnerships with link: https://our-jira/PROJECTS/PARTNER-5123 — required owners: maya.security, sam.partner-eng, priya.ops, jordan.legal.

alex.partnerships: Cool. One last ask from TitanEdge: they want to run a scoped 3rd-party pen-test on our integration (their SI will run it). We need to confirm a window and allowed targets. Maya — can you produce a short allowed-targets doc and the contact for on-call during the test?

maya.security: Yes. I'll add allowed targets + contact + safe-words to the bundle. We also need to stipulate that their SI must provide certs of scope, and we require a non-disclosure on the SI before any scans.

sam.partner-eng: Also note: if the SI needs to upload findings, prefer they use our upload endpoint with SAML auth rather than emailing reports. Saves us manual handling.

jordan.legal: We'll add SI NDA clause to the AAD.

alex.partnerships: Perfect. I'll update TitanEdge with this plan and set expectation for AAD first, then presigned links. I'll post a short roadmap to the partner PM. Thanks team :thumbsup:
